tagline.en_US: AirDC++ Web Client using the community-maintained gangefors image. Configuration, downloads and shared content use separate persistent paths.

description.en_US: AirDC++ Web Client is a web-based client for the Direct Connect file sharing network. It allows users to connect to hubs, browse peers, and manage file transfers through a browser interface. The application supports active and passive connectivity modes for transferring files across networks.
